validated_results.title: Polymorphisms of glutathione S-transferase genes (GSTM1, GSTP1 and GSTT1) and bladder cancer susceptibility in the Turkish population.
validated_results.reason: The study examines glutathione S-transferase gene polymorphisms, not nutritional glutathione exposure.

validated_results.title: Dependence of papanicolaou gradings of exfoliated urothelial cells upon GSTM1 and GSTT1 polymorphism in benzidine-exposed workers of the Shanghai dye industry.
validated_results.reason: Exposure is GSTM1/GSTT1 genotype and occupational benzidine, not nutritional glutathione, and the endpoint is cytological grading rather than cancer incidence.

validated_results.title: Obesity, interrelated mechanisms, and exposures and kidney cancer.

validated_results.title: Relationship between metabolic phenotype of N-acetylation and bladder cancer.
